_about: Gotthard Victor Lechler (1811-1888), professor at Leipzig: John Wycliffe and his English Precursors, translated from the German with additional notes by Peter Lorimer, new edition revised, with a chapter on the events after Wycliffe's death (London: Religious Tract Society, 1884). The proto-reformer of the English Reformation. The translator check looks for Lorimer. Internet Archive OCR, raw and unconverted; each title page read before listing.
